title: Maintenance

Although a clean home is socially valued, the work required to achieve it is not. House cleaning exists on the shadow side of the economy, on the margins or outside of paid employment. This film invites viewers to meditate on the ongoing maintenance work that makes other, more highly valued labour possible.
